perche: Z-C21.10, finding C8-2 (lot Z-C21.2). ChiaviGiaQuotate listed the dimensions with IView.GetFirstDisplayDimension5, and IView~GetFirstDisplayDimension5.html says it hands over «dimensions on both the sheet and sheet format. suppressed dimensions.»: a dimension HIDDEN BY HAND made its edge «already dimensioned», the edge was skipped in every other view, and the answer said «gia' quotata in un'altra vista» while the paper showed no dimension at all. The fix leaves out a display dimension whose annotation is hidden (IAnnotation~Visible.html: «This property determines whether an annotation has been individually displayed or hidden if you selected and specifically hid the annotation»; swAnnotationHidden = 3), in ApiHelpers.IsHiddenByHand.
perche_e_in_attesa: No operation of the catalogue hides a dimension, and the runner cannot do it before a step: this case needs a preamble field like «prima_seleziona» and «prima_nascondi» (CasiDichiarati.cs). Proposed: «prima_nascondi_quote»: { «vista»: «V1» } — before the step, every display dimension of that view of the current sheet is hidden AS BY HAND: its annotation selected (IAnnotation.Select3) and IModelDoc2.HideDimension called (IModelDoc2~HideDimension.html: «Hides the selected dimension in this document.»); then each annotation is read back, and one whose IAnnotation.Visible is not swAnnotationHidden is a BENCH ERROR, not a green (a hide that did not happen would make this case prove nothing). The count of hidden dimensions is printed, like «prima_nascondi». The case moves to Banco/casi/tavola/ in the commit that brings the field, with a bench run.
il_difetto_che_questo_caso_prende: Step 6 hides by hand the 120 and the 10 of the front view, then dimensions the top view. The 120 is on the paper nowhere, so it must be placed: on library 0.140.0 the first expectation of step 6 is RED, because the hidden 120 still counts and the 120 is skipped as «already dimensioned in another view». Step 7 is the other half: the 80 placed in step 6 is VISIBLE and must still count (skipped in the side view), while the hidden 10 must not (placed): the filter leaves out the hidden dimensions only.
i_numeri: Plate 120 x 80 x 10 = 96000 mm3, centred, extruded up from the top plane: X from -60 to 60 (the 120), Y from 0 to 10 (the 10), Z from -40 to 40 (the 80). viste_standard: V1 front (X and Y), V2 top (X and Z), V3 side (Z and Y). Step 5, V1: 120 and 10, 2 dimensions. Step 6, both hidden; V2: 120 (hidden in V1, so not dimensioned) and 80: 2 dimensions, hidden_dimensions_not_counted = 2. Step 7, V3: 80 (visible in V2: skipped) and 10 (hidden in V1: placed): 1 dimension, and still 2 hidden. On 0.140.0 step 6 gives 1 dimension (80), with the 120 among gia_quotate_altrove.
